claims.statement: The tagged independent-set count identity S(T,p)=A_p(T,p)-A_(p-1)(T,p) and selector decomposition Delta_p(T-v)=Delta_p(H_v)+Delta_(p-1)(R_v) are exact. They leave the eligible complete-aggregate sign open. The three replayed T_m rows are bounded corroboration at already historically sampled parameter/rank points.
claims.scope: Finite ordinary trees under the frozen definitions, with p=alpha(T)-2 and x(T)+2<=p for the primary target; the algebraic identities themselves require only an original leaf and induced deletions.
claims.reason: Direct partition of independent sets proves the count identity; partition by support membership proves the selector decomposition. The replay matches the pinned calculation byte for byte. Prior r24 TD-16 already sampled these same T_m parameter values at p=alpha-2, so the calculation should not be presented as new coverage. Neither identity nor finite check settles the sign.

limitations: No proof or eligible positive complete-aggregate counterexample for the primary target was obtained.
The polynomial calculation is a same-code replay at m=75,100,150, not an independent implementation or a universal argument.
No Lean build or full tree census was performed.
